single_experimental_change.name: fixed causal first-candidate refractory period
single_experimental_change.rule: emit the first N=16 candidate immediately; suppress a later candidate of the same key when its distance from the last kept candidate is between 1 and 2205 samples inclusive
single_experimental_change.anchor_update: only a kept candidate replaces the anchor; a suppressed candidate never extends the window
single_experimental_change.next_candidate_is_eligible_when: distance from the last kept candidate is greater than 2205 samples

execution_integrity.treatment: N=16 with the fixed 2205-sample refractory period
required_exact_control_reproduction: public candidate multiset globally and on every track
official TP FP FN globally and on every track
Exp08 false-positive relation partition globally and on every track
required_treatment_invariants: treatment candidates form a multiset subset of control candidates
control count equals kept plus suppressed by type track and private channel
every suppression is caused only by the last kept candidate of the same type and private channel at a distance from 1 through 2205 samples
a suppressed candidate never moves the anchor
retained candidates of one type and private channel are separated by more than 2205 samples
cross-channel candidates never suppress each other

required_post_change_audit: predictions TP FP FN precision recall and F1 for onset and offset
predictions per second and prediction-to-reference ratio
suppression distance bins at 1 5 10 20 and 50 ms
signed absolute and causal timing errors for official matches
control and treatment false-positive relation partitions using the Exp08 definitions
original control status of suppressed occurrences: matched isolated strong-repeat single-near or ambiguous
net TP and FP changes after complete one-to-one rematching
one-to-one same-channel per-note onset-only offset-only both and neither support
F1 direction for every track and family-arrangement group
raw candidate counts output density threshold and all causal invariants

training_audit_not_applicable.target_density: unchanged because there is no training change
training_audit_not_applicable.sample_weights: unchanged because there is no training change
training_audit_not_applicable.sampler_distribution: unchanged because there is no training change
training_audit_not_applicable.loss_constant_output_optimum: unchanged because there is no training change

interpretation_guards: this is a fixed causal refractory period retaining the first candidate, not a peak-maximum selector
the annotation gap minima do not guarantee zero TP loss because an earlier false candidate can occupy the window
the private channel is supervised from GuitarSet and the treatment therefore depends indirectly on that private channel
private channel is never published as string fret pitch or public type
the treatment cannot merge one acoustic reaction when the model spreads it across several channels
the treatment does not associate onset with offset
validation matching is an offline measurement and not a live association algorithm
